study.question: Does adding a masked within-block ordinal/value moment to the best target-match compression improve full-validation click AUC over the frozen duplicate-channel incumbent and a norm-matched scrambled-position control, and does its benefit depend on task-specific residual routing?
study.hypothesis: Observed validation trajectory, all under the frozen protocol and one training seed: baseline-din click AUC0.6555440824. The frozen sources g2-r0004-context_only and g3-r0003-embedding_item_primary achieved0.6606469405 and0.6601633627. The first compressed/task-scoring combination g0-r0006-compressed_task regressed to0.6591942389; g0-r0006-events_task reproduced the event source0.6601633627. Source-anchored task scoring g0-r0007-anchored_task_query reached0.6604926719 versus shared-query0.6606469405. The residual feedback-contrast g0-r0008-task_contrast reached0.6605806372 versus capacity control g0-r0008-task_capacity0.6606593148. Target-match detail was more promising: g0-r0009-match_detail_task0.6630190236 versus its shared0.6616459257 and count-only task0.6609444318 controls. Round10 field-separated detail underperformed mean replication in both routing cells (task0.6619952395 versus0.6627212597; shared0.6612800918 versus0.6617308731), and none exceeded the smaller round9 model. Round11 centered feedback interaction also underperformed duplicate detail in both cells: task0.6628510066 versus0.6632106916 and shared0.6618385394 versus0.6619460054. The new incumbent g0-r0011-duplicate_detail_task has32108261 parameters,315045 dense,329.9722505 wall seconds, 0.1823240060 click Logloss, and auxiliary AUCs cart0.7698432607/fav0.7806015488/buy0.7674598266. Its auxiliary performance remains below DIN, so click gains do not imply all-task dominance. No reported run above failed execution; their null/negative mechanism findings are scientific counterevidence, not execution errors. Repeated same-seed reproductions are consistency checks, not independent support. Current static source audit identifies a different limitation: both block/feedback means and match covariance are invariant to joint event/feedback permutation within each block. No input-order code reaches the scorer or residual. Hypothesis: a centered ordinal/value moment preserves a useful within-block direction that these summaries discard; task-specific residual readout can use that direction more effectively than shared readout. This is a prospective implementation hypothesis; existing outcomes establish neither order relevance nor the proposed mechanism.

study.proposed_difference: For block b of10 slots, set m=history_mask, p_j=j/9 for j=0..9 and n_b=sum_j m_j. Compute a_bj=m_j*(p_j-sum_k m_k*p_k/max(n_b,1)). The chronological detail is D_p=sum_bj a_bj*v_bj/sqrt(max(total_history_count,1)); v includes supplied item embeddings and historical action only. Retain the original match/value covariance as the first detail channel. The second channel replaces its redundant copy, so no parameters are added. Scrambled controls use the preregistered rank permutation [5,0,8,3,6,1,9,4,7,2]/9, centered on valid slots and rescaled per block by sqrt(sum(a^2)/max(sum(scrambled_centered^2),1e-12)). This matches coefficient L2 norms in FP32 including partially padded blocks; BF16 contraction can introduce rounding differences. All four cells compute both coefficient builders and use the same two-row contraction shape. Cross temporal_detail=position/scrambled with residual_routing=task/shared. Each task executes all four adapters; task routing selects its adapter and shared routing averages the bank. Auxiliary ordinal details are detached exactly as existing item/match paths are. No mutable temporal state or new random draws occur. These are within-block input ordinals, not elapsed-time recency, global block positions, or an estimate of feedback maturity. All positions from an empty or singleton block have zero coefficient. Finite padded values contribute zero. The proposal evolved from a duplicate-only control draft before any training: a scrambled control was added to distinguish chronological order from arbitrary signed compression. No model evaluation was run or discarded.
predictions: Primary prospective contrast: position_task minus scrambled_task click AUC is positive, with an exploratory practical target >=0.0002, and position_task exceeds frozen incumbent0.6632106916323903 and both frozen source AUCs. A gain over sources alone does not attribute anything to the new channel.

Task-conditioning claim requires a positive difference of differences: (AUC(position_task)-AUC(scrambled_task))-(AUC(position_shared)-AUC(scrambled_shared)). Also compare each chronological cell to its frozen duplicate-channel routing counterpart; the four new cells give the matched contemporaneous factorial, while the frozen anchors share the recipe/seed/capacity but execute a different unused summary.

The ordinal helper should change on constructed within-block event reversals while original compression, match detail and match counts remain equal. This is tested on the helper or a controlled nonzero residual, because all output projections initially equal zero and freshly initialized predictions intentionally coincide.

FP32 centered ordinal and scrambled coefficient norms match for every block mask; padded values and current target action never affect these details. Host forward/backward/masking and source-gradient checks must pass before substantive training.

Use existing predeclared history bins empty/1-16/17-64/>64 with all sample/positive/negative counts. A larger chronological advantage on longer histories is an exploratory diagnostic, not a selection rule. Do not infer trained empty-history predictions must be equal: shared context/embedding parameters can diverge during training.

All four new cells have32108261 expected parameters,315045 dense, identical train data passes and contraction/bank shapes. Chronological versus scrambled quality gains should have <=15% matched wall-time and p50/p95 model-latency overhead to support a practical efficiency claim; otherwise report the measured quality-cost tradeoff without claiming efficiency.

Report all four task AUCs/Logloss and auxiliary mean separately. One seed and adaptive validation search remain preliminary; positive same-seed factorial contrasts require paired additional seeds and feasible paired user-cluster uncertainty before repeated mechanism support.
falsifiers: If position_task does not improve over scrambled_task, useful chronological alignment is unsupported for this compression/readout. If both improve over the duplicate anchor equally, an independent signed compression channel is a plausible explanation, not a chronology result.
If neither chronological cell exceeds its routing-matched frozen duplicate anchor or the best incumbent, this implementation has no supported utility even if some lower reference is beaten.

A nonpositive difference of differences leaves extra benefit from task conditioning unsupported. Shared improvement can support a generic ordinal channel without supporting task-specific complementarity.

Any forward boundary violation, padding dependence, missing-mask fallback, current-action dependence, loss of auxiliary detachment or scorer-state ownership invalidates affected trials. Failed attempts and checks remain charged; no silent protocol fixes.

If host module counts differ across cells, initial predictions differ across cells under shared seed/state, or the original detail and scorer operators change, do not interpret the run as the planned mechanism contrast.

If apparent gains vanish under paired seed repetition, user-cluster uncertainty or measured cost comparison, retain the negative/ambiguous outcome. Failure of this single ordinal moment does not refute all sequence-aware compression.
alternative_explanations: The ordinal channel provides an extra signed embedding statistic; deterministic arbitrary compression may work as well. The norm-matched scrambled replacement directly tests this alternative.

One fixed scramble does not average over all arbitrary projections; even a positive contrast needs another preregistered permutation before a broad order claim. Sign inversion alone is not an informative scramble because a learned adapter can invert it.

Coefficient L2 matching controls linear magnitude, not embedding covariance, activation distributions, target conditioning or effective information rank. Differences can affect optimization under the frozen one-pass recipe.
Task-specific versus shared routing changes gradient sharing and effective task capacity despite equal allocated parameters and bank execution. A task main effect is not an ordering mechanism.

Pre-padding/truncation and ten-slot block boundaries can encode history-length and alignment artifacts. Ordinals preserve released order but do not verify elapsed-time recency. Existing block means are also invariant to consistent block permutations, which the proposed within-block moment still does not fully resolve.
Adaptive reuse of validation and a single common training seed can select noise. Prior source reproductions provide no independent random-initialization evidence.

The input benchmark carries whole-window vocabulary/static snapshot and official_offline feedback-maturity assumptions. Results cannot establish point-in-time production validity or advertisement-specific conversion attribution.

Zero output initialization and frozen optimization may undertrain a useful new channel; inspect host finite/nonzero residual gradients and fitted channel use if a promising but unsuccessful result justifies a follow-up. A scientific null and failed execution remain different conditions.
